title: Выход в космос: Праздники (Промпт)
description: Скопируй промпт в чат с ИИ и поговори о праздниках и фестивалях. Станция засчитывается, когда ты реально поговорил.

promptCard.prompt: Ты — мой сверстник из англоговорящей страны _________. Мне ____ лет. Давай поговорим на английском языке какие праздники или фестивали вы отмечаете в твоей стране. Отвечай на мои вопросы и задавай свои на эту тему. Используй Present Simple. Исправь меня, если я ошибусь, но только  в конце нашего диалога и в очень дружеской форме)

extra.title: Страны и праздники
lines: Russia — New Year, Victory Day, Maslenitsa, Russia Day.
USA — Independence Day, Thanksgiving, Halloween, Christmas.
United Kingdom — Christmas, Boxing Day, Bonfire Night, Easter.
France — Bastille Day, Christmas, Easter, Carnival season.
Germany — Oktoberfest, Christmas markets, Christmas, New Year.
Spain — La Tomatina, Semana Santa, San Fermín, Christmas.
Italy — Carnival of Venice, Easter, Christmas, Ferragosto.
Brazil — Carnival in Rio, New Year, Festa Junina, Christmas.
Mexico — Day of the Dead, Independence Day, Christmas, Holy Week.
India — Diwali, Holi, Eid, Navratri, Independence Day.
China — Chinese New Year, Mid-Autumn Festival, Dragon Boat Festival.
Japan — Hanami, New Year, Obon, Children's Day.
South Korea — Chuseok, Lunar New Year, Buddha’s Birthday.
Thailand — Songkran, Loy Krathong, New Year.
Australia — Australia Day, ANZAC Day, Christmas, New Year.
Canada — Canada Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year.

extra.title: Примерные вопросы для разговора
lines: 1.Are festivals in your country similar to festivals in Russia?
2.What festival from another country would you like to visit?
3.Do young people in your country enjoy national holidays?
4.Which country do you think has the most interesting celebrations?
5.If you could join one festival in another country, which one would you choose?
6.What is the most exciting part of a festival for you?
7.Do festivals bring people together in your country?
8.How do people usually prepare for a big celebration?
9.Do you prefer big public festivals or small family celebrations?
10.What would you show a tourist about your country’s holidays?
